about.title: About
about.description: What Outlap is, where the data comes from, how we check stories, what the site stores and how to get in touch.
about.lead: An unofficial Formula 1 site in English and Ukrainian: results since 1950, drivers, teams, circuits, stories with sources and explainers for newcomers. No ads, and free.

items.name: Seasons and races
items.p: Every season since 1950: standings, calendar and the result of every race; qualifying from 1994 and a lap-by-lap chart from 1996.

items.name: Drivers and teams
items.p: Cards with careers, wins, titles and teammates.

items.name: Circuits
items.p: Winners and every race held at each circuit, plus facts and maps.

items.name: Stories
items.p: Scandals, upsets and how-it-works explainers with every fact checked.

items.name: New to F1
items.p: The rules in plain words and a glossary whose terms pop up as hints in the texts.

items.name: Play
items.p: A hot lap on four tracks against a bot.

p: Results, standings and the calendar come from the open Jolpica F1 database, the successor to Ergast. From March to December, after a race the site checks for new results every hour on Sunday and into Monday morning, and again on Monday and Thursday.

News is headlines and links from Formula1.com, Motorsport.com and Autosport, plus posts by journalists on Bluesky. We show the headline, a short summary and a link to the original. Race videos come from the official FORMULA 1 YouTube channel.
data.more: The full list of sources, licences and photo authors is on the “{page}” page.

check.p1: Every number, date and quote in a story has a footnote with its source. Each claim shows how well it is supported:
check.p2: When sources disagree we show both versions and explain who says what. We prefer FIA documents, official classifications, interviews with the people involved and contemporary press. Wikipedia is not used as a source. Every story shows the date it was checked.
check.p3: The rules on the New to F1 page are checked against the 2026 FIA regulations, Pirelli documents and formula1.com; sources are listed under each section.

items.name: Visits
items.p: Anonymous Vercel Web Analytics statistics: how many times pages were opened and where visitors came from. No cookies and no data that identifies a person.

items.name: Theme, records and game settings
items.p: Your light or dark theme, your best laps and the last track you picked in the game are kept only in your browser. They are never sent to the server.

items.name: News images and videos
items.p: News images and video previews load from the publishers' sites (formula1.com, motorsport.com, YouTube), so those sites see your request.

unofficial.p: Outlap is not affiliated with Formula 1, the FIA or any team. F1, FORMULA 1 and related marks are trademarks of Formula One Licensing B.V. Team names belong to their owners. There are no team or Formula 1 logos on the site.

contact.label: Errors, sources, photo credits
contact.p: Write to us if you have found a mistake in the data or a story, have a better source, or took a photo and want its credit changed or the photo removed.
contact.pending: The contact address will appear together with the site's domain.
